query:
insert into TestCases (
                    latest_collection,
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name,
                    name,
                    state,
                    description_hash,
                    utc_date,
                    duration_sec
                )
                values (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    $4,
                    $5,
                    $6,
                    $7,
                    $8
                )
                on conflict (
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name,
                    name
                ) do update
                set
                    latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                    state = excluded.state,
                    description_hash = excluded.description_hash,
                    utc_date = excluded.utc_date,
                    duration_sec = excluded.duration_sec
